request.query: Map of monoid algebra induced by degree additive homomorphism sends monomial to monomial

items.name: Polynomial.mapAlgHom_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Semiring B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (n : ℕ) (a : A),
  (Polynomial.mapAlgHom f) ((Polynomial.monomial n) a) = (Polynomial.monomial n) (f a)

items.name: MonoidAlgebra.mapRangeAlgHom_single
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_4} {B : Type u_5} {M : Type u_7} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A]
  [inst_2 : Semiring B] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] [inst_5 : Monoid M] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (m : M)
  (a : A), (MonoidAlgebra.mapRangeAlgHom M f) (MonoidAlgebra.single m a) = MonoidAlgebra.single m (f a)

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRangeAlgHom_single
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_4} {B : Type u_5} {M : Type u_7} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A]
  [inst_2 : Semiring B] [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] [inst_5 : AddMonoid M] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (m : M)
  (a : A), (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRangeAlgHom M f) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single m a) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single m (f a)

items.name: Algebra.Generators.Hom.toAlgHom_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  {P : Algebra.Generators R S ι} {R' : Type u_1} {S' : Type u_2} {ι' : Type u_3} [inst_3 : CommRing R']
  [inst_4 : CommRing S'] [inst_5 : Algebra R' S'] {P' : Algebra.Generators R' S' ι'} [inst_6 : Algebra R R']
  [inst_7 : Algebra S S'] (f : P.Hom P') (v : ι →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  f.toAlgHom ((MvPolynomial.monomial v) r) = r • v.prod fun x1 x2 => f.val x1 ^ x2
